say:3:1210446001:1.text: We didn't catch up with the Water Wights. They tricked us...
say:3:1210446001:1.source_cn: 没追上，那帮水鬼骗了我们……

say:5:1210446003:1.text: Don't blame Lucca. Who knew the Water Wights would split into two groups?
say:5:1210446003:1.source_cn: 也不能怪卢卡，谁知道水鬼在我们眼皮子底下还能兵分两路呢？

say:6:1210446004:0.text: Those Wights know the waters well. They must've drawn our attention at the docks when they jumped on their ship so the actual person with the blueprints could dive below the water.
say:6:1210446004:0.source_cn: 水鬼水性好，应该是在码头时用一艘船吸引了我们的注意力，...

say:10:1210446005:1.text: Don't blame yourself. You did what you could.
say:10:1210446005:1.source_cn: 你做的够好了，不要自责。

say:13:1210446006:1.text: We can't let it end like this, Sonja.

say:16:1210446007:1.text: Of course. We'll get to the bottom of this.

say:17:1210446008:1.text: How did the Water Wights get in? How did they know about our cannon project? They were able to raid our facility and steal our blueprints within a day. Either the enemy had infiltrated our facility already or there's a mole in the gang.
say:17:1210446008:1.source_cn: 水鬼是怎么潜入这里的？怎么知道我们在研究大炮的？今天他...

say:20:1210446009:1.text: Hm, I've been thinking about that. How did they know our location?
say:20:1210446009:1.source_cn: 我也想知道，他们是怎么摸到这的？要说没有人带路，我可不信！

say:24:1210446011:1.text: Hugin, how did the magister get here?
say:24:1210446011:1.source_cn: 呼金，这位魔法师大人是怎么到这里的？
say:24:1210446011:1.male: Hugin, how did the magister get here?
say:24:1210446011:1.female: Hugin, how did the magister get here?

say:25:1210446012:1.text: Do you think it's us again? We just helped you fight off the Water Wights!
say:25:1210446012:1.source_cn: 咦？你是在怀疑我们吗？我们刚才还帮你打走了水鬼呢！

say:26:1210446013:1.text: We Whispers hate betrayal. But don't worry, I know you've helped us. I just want to confirm how you got here from Darkstone Cave.
say:26:1210446013:1.source_cn: 血薇痛恨背叛。\n但别担心，无论怎样，你们刚才都帮了血...

choice_prompt:27:1210446013.text: We Whispers hate betrayal. But don't worry, I know you've helped us. I just want to confirm how you got here from Darkstone Cave.
choice_prompt:27:1210446013.source_cn: 血薇痛恨背叛。\n但别担心，无论怎样，你们刚才都帮了血薇帮。我只是确认一下，你们怎么从黑石洞到这里的。

say:30:1210446014:1.text: Yes, if we were with the Water Wights, we would've escaped during the chaos.
say:30:1210446014:1.source_cn: 对，如果我们是水鬼，刚才为什么不趁乱逃走？

say:33:1210446018:1.text: Why do you keep mentioning Merlin? Is that supposed to be some great name or title?
say:33:1210446018:1.source_cn: 梅林是什么了不起的名号，为什么一次次提起？
say:33:1210446018:1.male: Why do you keep mentioning Merlin? Is that supposed to be some great name or title?
say:33:1210446018:1.female: Why do you keep mentioning Merlin? Is that supposed to be some great name or title?

say:36:1210446019:0.text: ... You're that Merlin! Of course! That's incredible!
say:36:1210446019:0.source_cn: ——了不起！当然了不起！非常了不起！太了不起了！
say:36:1210446019:0.male: ... You're that Merlin! Of course! That's incredible!
say:36:1210446019:0.female: ... You're that Merlin! Of course! That's incredible!

say:37:1210446020:1.text: No wonder your magic is so powerful! By the gods, I'm actually talking to Magister Merlin, and he's alive!
say:37:1210446020:1.source_cn: 难怪你的魔法如此精妙！天呐，诸神在上，我居然见到了梅林...
say:37:1210446020:1.male: No wonder your magic is so powerful! By the gods, I'm actually talking to Magister Merlin, and he's alive!
say:37:1210446020:1.female: No wonder your magic is so powerful! By the gods, I'm actually talking to Magister Merlin, and she's alive!

say:39:1210446022:1.text: Merlin is a legendary mage! In my master's copy of "The Book of Magic", there were 36 pages of Merlin's achievements and adventures. He once went deep into the desert alone and found a land of ice and snow...
say:39:1210446022:1.source_cn: 梅林，举世闻名的传奇魔法师！老师的《魔能宝典》里花了3...
say:39:1210446022:1.male: Merlin is a legendary mage! In my master's copy of "The Book of Magic", there were 36 pages of Merlin's achievements and adventures. He once went deep into the desert alone and found a land of ice and snow...
say:39:1210446022:1.female: Merlin is a legendary mage! In my master's copy of "The Book of Magic", there were 36 pages of Merlin's achievements and adventures. She once went deep into the desert alone and found a land of ice and snow...

say:42:1210446023:1.text: Alright, I got it. Get to the point.

say:43:1210446024:1.text: In short, there is no way that Magister Merlin is working for the Water Wights. I swear on my tools and on the reputation of me and my master.
say:43:1210446024:1.source_cn: 总之，水鬼帮绝对没法使唤梅林，我用铁头，火墙，矮地和老...
say:43:1210446024:1.male: In short, there is no way that Magister Merlin is working for the Water Wights. I swear on my tools and on the reputation of me and my master.
say:43:1210446024:1.female: In short, there is no way that Magister Merlin is working for the Water Wights. I swear on my tools and on the reputation of me and my master.

say:47:1210446026:1.text: If Hugin is swearing upon his master's reputation, is there any doubt?
say:47:1210446026:1.source_cn: 呼金都拿出老师的人格担保了，还有什么值得怀疑的吗？

say:48:1210446027:1.text: I'm not doubting him. I'm just thinking about how to apologize.
say:48:1210446027:1.source_cn: 不是怀疑。只是在想，该怎么道歉。

say:52:1210446029:1.text: I've never seen Hugin admire anyone other than his master. Although I've never heard of Merlin, I can feel the weight of this title.
say:52:1210446029:1.source_cn: 我没见呼金这么崇拜他老师以外的第二个人。虽然我没听说过...
say:52:1210446029:1.male: I've never seen Hugin admire anyone other than his master. Although I've never heard of Merlin, I can feel the weight of this title.
say:52:1210446029:1.female: I've never seen Hugin admire anyone other than his master. Although I've never heard of Merlin, I can feel the weight of this title.

say:53:1210446030:1.text: You must be a remarkable person. Apologies for my misunderstanding earlier.
say:53:1210446030:1.source_cn: 你应该是很了不起的人物。抱歉，误会了。
say:53:1210446030:1.male: You must be a remarkable person. Apologies for my misunderstanding earlier.
say:53:1210446030:1.female: You must be a remarkable person. Apologies for my misunderstanding earlier.

say:54:1210446031:1.text: Come back with us to Rustport. You will be our guest of honor. We need the power of a mage.
say:54:1210446031:1.source_cn: 跟我们回锈锚港吧，让我们以血薇帮最高礼遇招待你。我们需...
say:54:1210446031:1.male: Come back with us to Rustport. You will be our guest of honor. We need the power of a mage.
say:54:1210446031:1.female: Come back with us to Rustport. You will be our guest of honor. We need the power of a mage.

say:58:1210446033:1.text: Will Sinbad go back with us?

say:61:1210446034:1.text: Of course, I don't want to face those Water Wights again. It's safer with you.
say:61:1210446034:1.source_cn: 当然，我害怕再遇到水鬼。荒郊野岭的，还是和你们一起更安全。

say:62:1210446035:1.text: Oh wait, I haven't officially introduced myself to the leaders of the Carmine Whispers yet.
say:62:1210446035:1.source_cn: 对了，还没向血薇帮的老大和二当家自我介绍呢。

say:63:1210446036:1.text: Hello, I'm Sinbad. I'm usually around the docks if you need a hired hand.
say:63:1210446036:1.source_cn: 你们好，我是辛巴达，在码头上混饭吃的。

say:64:1210446037:1.text: Hello, Sinbad. I heard of you from Lucca.
say:64:1210446037:1.source_cn: 你好，辛巴达。我听卢卡说过你。

say:69:1210446039:1.text: Sinbad told us he'd help us get out of Rustport, but he brought us to see Hugin, and then we met you again.
say:69:1210446039:1.source_cn: 多亏了狡猾的辛巴达，我们本来要离开锈锚港的，又被他带来...

say:70:1210446040:1.text: Ha... You know life isn't easy here. I'm just trying to make my way in the world.
say:70:1210446040:1.source_cn: 啊哈……生活不易，领个路，赚点吃饭钱而已。

say:74:1210446042:1.text: Let me make it clear that I'm not a Water Wight! My village is always getting robbed by those damn seadogs. If I was with them, they wouldn't have beaten me senseless earlier.
say:74:1210446042:1.source_cn: 声明一下，我可不是水鬼！你也知道，我们村子经常被水鬼帮...

say:75:1210446043:1.text: Alright... let's go back to Rustport first. We have many matters to deal with now that the Water Wights are on the attack.
say:75:1210446043:1.source_cn: 总之……先回锈锚港吧，水鬼帮来袭，我们还有更紧急的事要处理。

narration:76:1210446044:1.text: You all are welcomed as guests of honor of the Carmine Whispers in Rustport.

choice:32:0:1.text: I am Magister Merlin after all.
choice:32:0:1.male: I am Magister Merlin after all.
choice:32:0:1.female: I am Magister Merlin after all.

say:80:1210446015:0.text: Yes, if we were traitors, why didn't the Water Wights take us with them when they retreated?
say:80:1210446015:0.source_cn: 对，如果我们是内鬼，水鬼帮撤退为什么不带我们？

say:83:1210446016:1.text: If the magister wanted to take this place, he wouldn't use these underhanded methods. Don't underestimate us!
say:83:1210446016:1.source_cn: 主人如果要攻占这里，哪里还需要卧底，太小看我们了！
say:83:1210446016:1.male: If the magister wanted to take this place, he wouldn't use these underhanded methods. Don't underestimate us!
say:83:1210446016:1.female: If the magister wanted to take this place, she wouldn't use these underhanded methods. Don't underestimate us!

choice:27:2:3.text: I'm too powerful to be a spy.
choice:27:2:3.male: I'm too powerful to be a spy.
choice:27:2:3.female: I'm too powerful to be a spy.
